paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.

Here’s a description of the plot, following the requested format:

The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing across a range of co-occurrence numbers. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number," using a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and is a linear scale ranging from 40 to 65, with tick marks every 5 percentage points. A blue solid line with circle markers represents one dataset, commencing at 39.2% at co-occurrence number 1 and increasing to 52.2% at 1000. A purple dashed line with triangle markers depicts another dataset, starting at 37.7% at co-occurrence number 1 and rising to 51.4% at 1000. A red solid line with diamond markers starts at 44.2% at co-occurrence number 1 and ascends to 49.8% at 1000. An orange dashed line with inverted triangle markers begins at 44.0% at co-occurrence number 1 and increases to 48.8% at 1000. A green solid line with square markers begins at 50.1% at co-occurrence number 1 and rises to 64.1% at 1000. A dark green solid line with square markers beings at 50.8% at co-occurrence number 1 and increasing to 65.4% at 1000.
